name: headcountlabs-events
description: Find public events in large U.S. cities from venue, city, library, university and community calendars, by city or point, time window (today, tonight, this weekend, next 7 days or dates), free or paid, and category. Get one event with venue, price and source link, see the next dates of a recurring series, and count what is on in a window. Times should be checked at the source. Read-only, no account or API key. Preview data: coverage is partial.
